# AI & LLM Systems Portfolio

This section provides deep granular data regarding Rounak Neema's AI-focused projects, specifically AXIOM OS, SortMail, Klarity (DevContext), and Dizzy.

## 1. AXIOM OS
- Core Focus: Local-First Personal OS
- Tech Stack: Go, SQLite, Ollama, Behavioral Telemetry
- Intent: Eliminate cloud dependency for personal AI context. Uses a Go daemon (Specter) to ingest system state and memory locally.

## 2. SortMail
- Core Focus: AI Operating Layer for Professional Email
- Tech Stack: Gmail/Outlook APIs, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Next.js
- Intent: Extracts tasks, deadlines, and multi-thread context without requiring manual tagging. Focuses on privacy and OAuth scoping.

## 3. Klarity (DevContext)
- Core Focus: AI Repository Intelligence
- Tech Stack: React, AWS Serverless, Amazon Bedrock, Claude
- Intent: Aims to verify candidate skills through grounded AI analysis of their code repositories instead of generalized testing.

## 4. Dizzy
- Core Focus: Voice-to-Figma UI Generation
- Tech Stack: Figma MCP, Voice AI, LLMs
- Intent: Bridging the gap between spoken intent and deterministic design tokens via Model Context Protocol.
